name: subscriber-sync
description: Adds people who submit your forms to Mailchimp, Brevo, MailerLite or Kit, with field mapping, an optional consent field and retries.

api_key.title: API key
api_key.description: Stored here and never shown again. Mailchimp keys end in -usNN.

list_id.title: List, audience, group or form id
list_id.description: Mailchimp audience id, Brevo list id (a number), MailerLite group id or Kit form id.

forms.title: Forms to sync
forms.description: Form slugs, one per line. Empty means nothing is sent.

consent_field.title: Consent field
consent_field.description: Optional. When set, only submissions where this field is ticked or yes are sent.

double_opt_in.title: Double opt-in
double_opt_in.description: Mailchimp only: new contacts get a confirmation email first. The other providers follow their own settings.

tags.title: Tags
tags.description: Tag names, one per line. Mailchimp and Kit only.
